item.title: What $100 actually gets you in Las Vegas in 2026 -- from the Strip to hidden gems
item.description: In Las Vegas, $100 can mean very different things depending on where you spend it.

item.title: 1 dead, 1 injured in attempted robbery in northeast Las Vegas, police say
item.description: Two men, one of whom was openly carrying a firearm, exchanged gunshots during an attempted robbery outside of a business near Lake Mead and Nellis boulevards, resulting in one death and one critical injury.

item.title: Three US service members killed, five seriously wounded in Iran operation: Military
item.description: They are the first reported American casualties since the U.S. and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran.

item.title: Iranian activist, Las Vegas protestors react to U.S bombings in Iran
item.description: Las Vegas resident and Iranian political activist, Simone Derayeh, said Iranians living in the U.S and abroad are celebrating the U.S military operation that crippled the Iranian Government and killed Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: WalletHub report ranks Las Vegas and Reno among best and worst cities for women
item.description: A new WalletHub study comparing the best and worst cities for women nationwide shows that Nevada’s largest metro areas fall in the middle of the pack when it comes to economic opportunity, health care access, and safety.

item.title: Las Vegas business owner sentenced in $4M fraud scheme
item.description: A Las Vegas business owner has been sentenced to four years in federal prison after prosecutors say he carried out a multimillion-dollar Ponzi-style fraud scheme that targeted a food brokerage company.

item.title: Strong winds expected to continue in Las Vegas area
item.description: Welcome to the first day of March, where we are still looking at the 80's for afternoon highs today.

item.title: Rambo inspiration, Vietnam vet Bo Gritz, dies at 87
item.description: The man who inspired Sylvester Stallone's "Rambo" film franchise passed away on Friday, at the age of 87, according to a post by his wife, Judy, on social media.

item.title: Iranian community celebrates U.S. strikes; Jewish leaders urge vigilance
item.description: Members of the Iranian community in Las Vegas took to the sidewalks in front of the Bellagio fountains on Sunday to celebrate recent attacks against the Iranian government.
